narrative.details:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety however is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me with Dondallion back in Valanaar. I need to return to him as soon as possible. He's probably going to pieces with worry.
narrative.objectives: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Dondallion Whisperwind in Valanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well, I confess that I am intensely relieved that Fillion has returned to us. He never was good at minding his surroundings. Always too busy lost in thought, or with his nose in a book.Thank you, champion.

quests.name: The Missing Scholar
quests.objectiveText: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Dondallion Whisperwind in Valanaar.

quests.name: Fillion's Mission
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.

quests.name: Catching Wind
quests.objectiveText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it once there.

quests.name: Avenged Tenfold
quests.objectiveText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.

quests.name: In Service of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
